name: Jackie Kaminski
original_name: ジャッキー・カミンスキー
source:
One of the few men on the base, Sergeant Jackie Kaminski is the top Non-Commissioned Officer (NCO). He respects brute force over anything else. The ultimate professional, he has the respect of everyone. However, he has a reputation for not getting "involved" with other troops, even though others currently have no self-control in that area. He was [url=https://vndb.org/c14808]Julietta[/url]'s drill sergeant at the Military Academy and she often relies on his judgement even though she is technically his superior.

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/562753-critical-point/faqs/19503]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
